summary_en: This phase 2 study tests venetoclax added to cladribine and low dose cytarabine, followed by cladribine, low dose cytarabine, and azacitidine, in patients with previously untreated acute myeloid leukemia. Venetoclax is taken by mouth, cladribine is given into a vein, cytarabine is given under the skin, and azacitidine is given under the skin or into a vein; how often and for how long is not stated. The record does not state the main outcome measured, and the study is listed as Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa venetoclax añadido a cladribina y citarabina en dosis bajas, seguido de cladribina, citarabina en dosis bajas y azacitidina, en pacientes con leucemia mieloide aguda no tratada previamente. El venetoclax se toma por vía oral, la cladribina se administra por vena, la citarabina se aplica debajo de la piel y la azacitidina se aplica debajo de la piel o por vena; la frecuencia y la duración no se indican. El registro no indica el resultado principal que se mide, y el estudio figura como de fase 2.
who_for: ECOG performance status of 2 or less
Able to understand the study and sign informed consent
not_for: Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or those of childbearing potential not using contraception
Uncontrolled illness such as active infection, symptomatic heart failure, unstable angina, or cardiac arrhythmia
Documented hypersensitivity to components of the chemotherapy program
